method.unit: One currently available consumer-facing item, not a wholesale, blank-garment, or print-provider cost.
method.target: Benchmark price less $2.00, except where the verified production and estimated payment-fee floor is higher.
method.shipping: Shipping is separate. When a comparator includes free shipping, subtract the verified first-item US Printify rate from the competitor's delivered-price target.
method.fees: The 3.5% + $0.50 allowance is a conservative planning estimate, not the verified Stripe fee.
method.unmatched: If a current, sufficiently similar single-item retail offer was not verified, keep the existing proposal rather than infer a competitor price.

pricingPolicy.shipping: Separate customer charge using the verified Printify catalog rate; WooCommerce checkout shipping is not yet end-to-end verified.
pricingPolicy.disclaimer: The cost floor includes only recorded Printify production cost and estimated payment fees. It does not verify Stripe fees, taxes, refunds, chargebacks, or other operating costs.
